name: Agadir
coordsNote: City centre behind the main beach (Talborjt / seafront); Founty and the Marina sit 1–3 km south and north along the bay; Taghazout surf villages ~20 km north.

english.rationale: Morocco scores 492 on EF EPI (Low band, #68) and Agadir itself 485, slightly under the national figure; French is the main second language. English is fine in hotels, surf camps and the seafront, thinner elsewhere. Unlike Marrakech no expat-hub bump: the long-stay community is largely French-speaking.

vibe: Modern Atlantic resort city, long sandy bay, surf villages up the coast
narrative: Rebuilt after the 1960 earthquake, Agadir is a low-rise, modern resort city: a long crescent beach and promenade, the Souk El Had market, the hilltop Kasbah Oufella ruins, fresh fish at the port and surf at Taghazout and Tamraght 20 km north. Calmer and more conventional than Marrakech, with a long-standing European winter crowd — but there is no old medina to speak of, and the Atlantic rarely tops 21 °C.

season.rationale: Editorial estimate. Two seasons: European (British-led) winter sun from October to April, with Christmas–New Year near full (~90% expected occupancy), and a domestic summer peak — forecast occupancy 60% Jun, 68% Jul, 84% Aug, with Moroccan holidaymakers at least half of late-July–August activity. May–June and September are the gaps. Jan–Apr 2025 classified-hotel occupancy averaged 60.8% with the UK at ~26% of arrivals.

safety.propertyNote: Beach and souk pickpocketing, bag-snatching; calmer than Marrakech
safety.womensSafetyNote: Unwanted attention for women alone; less intense than Marrakech

rationale.property: Editorial estimate. FCDO says petty crime is common in Moroccan tourist areas, including beaches, but crime against visitors concentrates in Marrakech, Casablanca, Fes and Tangier; Agadir's modern resort layout has no maze-like medina. Set above Marrakech (55) but well below the Spanish coast (65-70).
rationale.tourist: Hustling and fake guides exist but are far milder than in Marrakech's medina, which is why Marrakech carries 0.95; resort-zone visitors face roughly local risk, so 1.0.
rationale.womens: FCDO notes women may face unwanted attention, particularly alone. Agadir is a more relaxed, beach-oriented city than Marrakech (-23), so roughly half that delta.

selection: Atlantic winter-sun base with a long-established European snowbird community and surf at Taghazout 20 km north; fills the Dec–Feb window and adds an African coastal option beside Marrakech.
researchNotes: Timezone: Morocco keeps UTC+1 year-round except during Ramadan, when it switches to UTC+0 (e.g. 7 Feb – 14 Mar 2027 per calendarific). US advisory: level, date and risk text verified from the State Dept RSS feed (travel.state.gov/_res/rss/TAsTWs.xml); the advisory page linked from the feed returned HTTP 403, so I could not read which 'areas have increased risk' (historically the Western Sahara / Algerian border regions, far from Agadir). Hazards empty: Agadir's Atlantic climate is mild; occasional chergui (Saharan wind) heat spikes are short-lived and should show in the climate data. Seismic risk (1960 quake) is real but not a monthly hazard.
